rapid_click_3f.what: click train, one every 3 frames (9.99/s) at 29.97 fps; 1 s

rapid_click_2f.what: click train, one every 2 frames (15/s); 1 s

rapid_click_1f.what: click train, one per frame (30/s); 1 s

rapid_click_ramp.what: click train accelerating from 6/s to 30/s; 1 s

mech_click_a.what: mechanical key, linear thock: down and up stroke

mech_click_b.what: mechanical key, clicky switch: double click down, up stroke

button.what: UI press: click plus a short blip, then release

whoosh.what: band-passed noise sweep, L to R; peak at 0.62 s

big_flash.what: bright transient: crack, burst, falling zap, sub, airy tail; hit at 0

whoosh_flash.what: whoosh into big_flash; flash hit at 0.62 s

glitch_2.what: stutter: one slice gated, speeding up

glitch_3.what: buffer repeat: a grain repeated, halving each time

zoom_riser.what: riser for the rapid zoom; peak at the end (1.0 s), place its end on the land
